Summary: Eternal security is the conviction that those truly united to Christ cannot finally be lost, because their keeping depends on God's faithfulness rather than their own grip. Jesus promised that no one can snatch His sheep from His hand, and Paul traced salvation from predestination to glorification without a break. This assurance is meant to produce humility and holiness, not carelessness, since those who persist in sin give reason to question whether they ever truly believed.
RelatedQuestions: Can I lose my salvation?; How can I know I am truly saved?
